SLIMEBOSS-SLURP.title: Slurp
SLIMEBOSS-SLURP.description: Add a random "Lick" card from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SLIMEBOSS-COMMAND.title: Command
